item.title: Anaheim Ducks Reassign Ian Moore To San Diego

item.title: Gulls’ Late Heroics Not Enough in Shootout Loss to Barracuda
item.description: By Ashley Rubin/SanDiegoGulls.com The San Diego Gulls forced overtime with a late goal over the San Jose Barracuda but were unable to grab the extra point in the shootout tonight at Pechanga Arena San Diego, 4-3. item.title: Gulls Take Two Points from IceHogs
item.description: By Ashley Rubin/SanDiegoGulls.com The San Diego Gulls took a comeback win over the Rockford IceHogs tonight at BMO Center, 5-4. There was a complete team effort put up by San Diego tonight as they took home their sixth all-time win over Rockford. The Gulls responded to each of Rockford’s goals and held a lead only in the third period, which ensured their win. item.description: By Ashley Rubin/SanDiegoGulls.com The San Diego Gulls look to keep their momentum going and take a sweep over the Rockford IceHogs tonight at BMO Center (2 p.m. PST; TV: AHLTV on FloHockey; Radio: Gulls Audio Network). item.title: San Diego Guls Recall Coulson Pitre and Roman Kinal From Tulsa
item.description: The San Diego Gulls announced today that the American Hockey League (AHL) club has recalled forward Coulson Pitre and defenseman Roman Kinal from Tulsa (ECHL).
